headline: Carvana Expands Same-Day Delivery to Eugene
summary: EUGENE, Ore., February 03, 2026--Carvana (NYSE: CVNA), an industry pioneer for buying and selling cars online, today announced the expansion of same-day vehicle delivery for customers in the greater Eugene area. Select local customers can now receive their vehicle as soon as the same day they place an order on Carvana.com.

headline: Carvana: The Subprime Cliff
summary: Carvana (CVNA) downgraded to Strong Sell: overvaluation, subprime loan risks, and regulatory scrutiny threaten margins.
